== virtualUSB

- Fixed an issue on macOS where iOS 17.4 and later devices failed to pair in the virtualUSB desktop app once about six devices were connected on the same Mac. Affected devices showed *Pairing failed* and did not appear in Xcode.
- Fixed an issue on macOS where iOS 17.4 and later devices connected with separate `vusb connect` commands stopped appearing in Xcode once about four devices were connected on the same Mac.

// REVIEWER NOTE: The device counts are approximate. The point where pairing failed in the
// desktop app varied with device name length, so the entry does not state an exact limit.
// QA verified up to ten devices in the desktop app plus three with `vusb connect` on one
// Mac. No supported device count is stated in the source, so none is published here.
//
// REVIEWER NOTE: The ticket's test plan expected faster `vusb connect` connections, but the
// sign-off does not record connection times. The speed improvement is left out until
// confirmed. Mixed desktop app and CLI use on one Mac passed QA but is not called out as a
// separate fix because the ticket's observed behavior does not describe it.
//
// REVIEWER NOTE: Confirm which virtualUSB build carries this fix before placing the entry.
// The Jira release comment lists virtualUSB 2610.21341.0 as part of a bulk update and notes
// that not every listed build applies to every ticket. An earlier engineering comment says
// the fix shipped in a consolidated branch build that would likely merge into the primary
// release. Consider grouping with other virtualUSB partials on the same page.
//
// REVIEWER NOTE: Scope is the macOS virtualUSB client only. Android devices, iOS 17.3 and
// earlier, and the Windows and Linux clients are not affected.
//
// REVIEWER NOTE: debugging:start-debugging.adoc still lists "iOS 17 and above devices are
// not supported" under Considerations. That appears out of date relative to this and related
